name: LeanCloud

evidence.nosql: D01: LeanStorage stores schema-free JSON objects in Classes, queried with REST constraints
evidence.backend: C02: backend platform with accounts, files and functions; C07: LeanStorage, LiveQuery and LeanEngine
evidence.sql: C02: optional managed SQL; D01: optional LeanDB MySQL, separately provisioned
evidence.kv: D01: optional LeanCache Redis 6 with native clients from LeanEngine
evidence.files: F01: 1 GB included file capacity; F04: SDK upload route documented
evidence.jobs: J04: six-field cron schedules and delayed tasks; J01: Cloud Queue (experimental, free)

line: Backend platform for data, files, user accounts, and server functions.

free.text: Existing: 30K req/day, 1GB DB; archives after 30d idle; closes Jan 12, 2027

cells.metered: Existing apps: $5/day intl floor; RMB30/day China
cells.regions: International or China; region terms differ
cells.selfhost: No, LeanCloud runs managed or private clusters

sql.math: $155 is the known minimum for 31 days on the international Business plan. API and database rates mean the exact total is not known.
The Business minimum, 31 × $5 a day, continues with no traffic for existing international apps. The service closes January 12, 2027.

files.math: $12.871 is the 30-day subtotal for capacity and delivery. File request charges, metadata and the exact total are not known.

jobs.math: A worker with 1 CPU and 512 MB costs $49.60 over 31 days. But the queue runs one job at a time, and five are required.
